verdict.rationale: Steel is itself a browser API, and its docs describe public API endpoints for Sessions, Captchas, Credentials, Files and Agent Traces. A live probe found a public OpenAPI spec at docs.steel.dev/openapi.json, and the open-source repo documents CDP-based programmatic control. A community member independently praised the docs and API reference, so first-party documentation, a machine-readable spec and independent corroboration are all present.
